title: documentation: Missing some widget icons
body:
Some widgets do not have a specific icon in the documentation, they are re-using other icons. Here is the list of icons to add:

* \[ ] hitsPerPageSelector
* \[ ] hierarchicalMenu
* \[ ] numericRefinementList
* \[ ] priceRanges

I also do not understand the `hits` icon. This looks like a graph to me.
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11030263/42d729a4-86cd-11e5-9f22-973edd35b4a0.png).
